race.description: Hunter Land Management F&M Mdn Hcp
race.comment: SHAHAAMEH (4) bumped into a smart one on debut at Warwick Farm then gets a pass mark for her follow-up run over 1400m at Rosehill last start when beaten around three lengths. Will find this easier and should be right in the finish. VELASTRA (10) has been safely held in her two runs to date, the latest over 1250m at Newcastle after a seven-week let-up. Draws the fence and might be ready to show something now. MUMBAI MAHARANI (3) comes here off a six-week let-up. Showed pace but didn't quite finish off when resuming last start over 1250m here. Subsequently trialled well and should put in a better performance this afternoon. IN HER NAME (5) didn't do a great deal on debut at Rosehill but should be given another chance.
